personality_one_liner: A rugged, no-nonsense industrial command center with oversized targets, high contrast, and a hero walkie-talkie voice interface built for the 8am jobsite.

spacing.rule: Generous and oversized. Minimum touch target height is 56pt to accommodate gloved hands. Avoid tight clustering.

dont's: Do not use any blur or glass effects. Brutalist UI relies on solid colors, thick 2pt borders (borderStrong), and hard structural contrast.

screens.name: Auth / Onboarding
screens.purpose: Google sign-in and rugged brand introduction.

states.error: Solid red (#DC2626) snackbar with stark white text.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image of construction site with a dark gradient scrim (top to bottom). Massive 'Google Sign In' button anchored at the bottom with a 2pt solid black border and 56pt minimum height. Oversized 'SubSidekick' wordmark in Barlow.

screens.name: Home / Daily Briefing
screens.purpose: AI-generated morning summary and voice-first interaction hub.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders using stark grey blocks.
states.error: Error card with a thick black outline and 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Rigid grid structure. Top: Large 'Morning Briefing' text block. Middle: Action-required list rows with thick dividers. Bottom: Fixed, oversized 'Push-to-Talk' mic FAB (walkie-talkie style) hovering directly above the bottom tab bar. When mic is pressed, display a stark waveform animation.

screens.name: Voice Chat (AI Foreman)
screens.purpose: Live conversation thread and tap-to-talk interface.

states.empty: Illustration of blueprint sketch with 'Tap and hold to talk' prompt.
states.error: Connection error banner with manual retry.

screens.layout: Message bubbles use hard-edged rectangles rather than soft pills. Transcriptions are large (18pt+). The bottom 1/3rd of the screen is dedicated to the massive Walkie-Talkie primary CTA (solid Industrial Orange, 2pt black border, active state color flip to black). Keep controls oversized.

screens.name: Jobs & Crews
screens.purpose: Status list of all ongoing jobs and crew assignments.

states.empty: Blueprint graphic with 'No active jobs' text.

screens.layout: Edge-to-edge list rows. Each row is highly structured: Job Name (oversized), GC/Status tags (solid pill tags with harsh contrast), separated by 1pt or 2pt black dividers. No floating cards.

screens.name: Job Detail
screens.purpose: Drill-down into progress, change orders, and back charges.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of safety helmet.

screens.layout: Header features a job site photo with a heavy scrim and white text. Segmented controls (using thick outlines, no soft shadows) to toggle between Progress, Orders, Charges. Data points are displayed as condensed metric blocks.

screens.name: Change Orders / Back Charges
screens.purpose: Dispute logging with photos, amounts, and timestamps.
screens.layout: List of large thumbnail-led rows for quick photo scanning. Tapping a row opens a full-screen view with a massive 'Approve/Reject' sticky footer (56pt tall buttons, full width).

screens.name: Office Digest
screens.purpose: Admin view of drafts needing review and signature.
screens.layout: Dashboard-like layout with stark status cards. 'Awaiting Signature' items use the Industrial Orange accent as a structural left-border. Heavy emphasis on 'Action Required' typography.

auth_hero.alt: Construction site with crane in morning light

avatar_foreman.alt: Rugged construction worker in hard hat

instructions_to_main_agent: VIBE & AESTHETIC: This is a Brutalist, high-contrast, 'work truck at 8am' UI. No glassmorphism, no soft shadows, no gentle pastels. Everything is structurally defined by 2pt borders (borderStrong), solid fills, and stark #FFFFFF / #09090B contrast.
TOUCH TARGETS: Crucial requirement - users will be wearing gloves. All Pressable elements MUST have a minimum height of 56pt. Ensure generous padding inside list items and inputs.

HERO INTERACTION (VOICE): The Walkie-Talkie interface is the star. Design the Push-to-Talk (PTT) button to be massive (taking up significant lower screen estate) with a solid 'brandPrimary' fill. Implement an inverted color flip (e.g., to black) on press. Provide stark waveform visual feedback.
TYPOGRAPHY: Use Barlow_700Bold for massive headers and structural labels. Use IBMPlexSans_500Medium for all body text to ensure extreme readability in daylight.
IMAGE HANDLING: Ensure any text laid over the 'auth_hero' or 'job_detail_hero' uses the exact vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) pattern to guarantee contrast.
BORDERS OVER SHADOWS: Strip out all React Native shadows (elevation/shadowColor). Use borderWidth: 2 and borderColor: theme.color.borderStrong to separate components.
